review:
The fortune-teller slot on Megaways – black cats, candles and tarot cards, with Madame Destiny as a wild that doubles any win she's in.

Three to six scatters pay 5x to 100x your stake and start free spins, where a wheel decides both the number of spins (up to 12) and a win multiplier up to 25x. That wheel gives every bonus a different shape. 96.56% RTP.
